route: scripted (procedural Blender geometry, rig and keyed clips; no provider generation)

skin.policy: rigid: one bone per vertex at weight 1.0

rootMotion: code-owned: the root joint is never animated and every clip plays in place

frame.note: encounter.ts rotation.y = -heading turns local -Z onto the heading

license: Original work generated in Blender from a checked-in script; concept reference from Paul's paid Higgsfield plan (Terms of Use 4.4)

checks: reimport gate (weights, influences, clips, root motion, bounds, sockets)
evaluated pose checks (floor, death on the floor, loop seams)

authorSelfScore.scorer: author self-score (the authoring agent; not the independent score create-rigged-character-assets requires)
gaps: The brass hue is unchanged: the front skirt still goes pale gold and the outer ring and back skirt cream under the key lights. The runtime replaces the brass slot with the shared brass-polished set (brass-aged renders paler still), so the fix is a runtime tint or a bronze shared set, outside this generator.
The keyhole core's hot centre stays saturated yellow rather than white-hot. In the EEVEE compare the keyhole reads close to a round disc with a short tail; the shape is clearer in the engine shots.
The pauldrons are still smooth domes with one engraved ring and three rivets, beside the concept's layered pauldrons.
Engraved panel lines and rivets are geometry and read at compare scale, but at play distance they are faint, and the brushed streak texture still looks stretched on the skirt.
Orbit band placement is unchanged: from the side it swings about 0.4 m in front of the chest, where the concept's side view keeps it behind the shoulders.
In the death pose the folded orbit band still intersects the halo rings on the floor.
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score on the reviewer's rubric: silhouette and proportions 24/30, signature features 23/25, surface detail and material read 13/20, colour and value 12/15, readability at play distance 9/10. Judged from orrery-warden.fidelity-compare.jpg (orthographic EEVEE renders of the low-poly model at the concept's front, side and back angles, framed at the concept's own scale, 2.70 m over the crop height) side by side and in zoomed crops of the chest, core, legs and feet, plus the six in-engine shots in staging/engine, which now render the warden-glow slot through the runtime D11 glow (writeGlowIslands and applyGlowLook from src/enemies/glow.ts). glow-close is the seat camera at the 50 degree lens of docs/verification/p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg and matched the previous committed still at a mean difference of 1.02/255 before this build. Silhouette: the lower legs are now slim calf lofts under two tapered greave lames with a front ridge, a knee cop and ankle cops, ending in pointed sabatons with three instep lames, a heel cup and a gunmetal sole. The box-palm hands are replaced by lofted gauntlets with a back plate, a knuckle bar, four three-segment fingers with dark joints and a two-segment thumb. The pauldrons are still domes and the orbit band still swings in front of the chest from the side. Signature: the round core disc is replaced by a keyhole (a ring over a tapering slot in a brass frame) with a glow channel running down the abdomen, and the head carries a raised brow plate and gunmetal cheek recesses. Surface: engraved grooves and riveted strips on the pectorals, pauldrons, vambraces and greaves are geometry (the GLB must stay image-free and the brass slot takes the shared set's normal map, so no normal-map bake). They read at compare scale but are subtle at play distance. Colour: the glow keeps the reviewer's measured amber. The brass is unchanged because the slot is replaced at runtime by the shared brass-polished set, so no generator-side lever moves its hue. In the engine glow-close shot the skirt median is (128,100,63) against the concept's (131,93,63): value matches, but the hue is yellower and the highlights go pale.

independentScore.scorer: independent reviewer agent (separate from the authoring agent; did not build the model)

rubric.note: The outline from the front is right: two halo rings, the tilted orbit band, the long tasset skirt. Confirmed changes: the feet are now pointed, segmented sabatons (clear in the idle and side views), and the hands are fingered gauntlets that close into a fist in the attack shot instead of box palms. The greaves are only partly slimmed. In the front ortho compare they are two stacked straight cylinders, about 30 px wide at the upper segment and 24 px at the lower (a stepped ratio of 0.8), while the concept greave swells at the calf (about 33 px) and narrows smoothly to about 23 px at the ankle, with knee cops the model lacks. The side view is unchanged: the torso is a thin column with no chest depth, the head is a round egg, the pauldrons are domes, and the orbit band still swings in front of the chest where the concept keeps it behind the shoulders.

All signature parts are present: two halo rings, the orbit band with ruby, sapphire and emerald planets, shoulder jewels, the eclipse disc and the sun core. The core is now a round glowing disc with a stem and a lit channel running down to the waist, so it reads as a keyhole with glow bleeding down the abdomen, though the disc stays much larger and rounder than the concept's small keyhole in a ribbed bezel. The mask has dark diagonal cheek recesses and a faint ledge above the eyes, but no clearly raised brow plate, and the eyes are large round goggle lenses where the concept has small narrow eye slits in an elongated skull mask.

Engraved detail is now visible in the engine shots: dark grooves with rivet heads on the vambraces and greaves, studs around the outer halo ring, and banded segments on the sabatons. The skirt tassets keep their gunmetal border grooves. The cuirass and the dome pauldrons are still largely smooth, without the concept's layered plate edges, and the brushed streak texture still swirls and stretches across the skirt. At play distance the new grooves read as thin dark slits rather than the concept's carved panel lines.

Measured as sRGB from p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg. Core: warm-pixel median (245,173,70) against the concept core (246,167,58), a match. Core centre 9x9 (250,206,76) and 95th percentile of the core disc (252,217,140), so the centre is still saturated yellow, not the concept's near-white peak (255,252,198). Eyes (240,184,77) against the previous concept measurement (247,196,75). Brass is unchanged and still too yellow and pale: chest plate median (116,92,56), hue 36 deg, lightness 0.34, against the concept chest (70,55,41), hue 29 deg, lightness 0.22. Skirt left panel hue 34 deg against the concept's 24 deg. The skirt 90th-percentile highlight is cream (233,212,178) against the concept's bronze (195,150,94). Planets keep correct jewel tones.

In the idle, attack, hit and frozen engine shots the core is the brightest saturated point, and the halo and planets set the Warden apart from the other automatons. The attack reach with a closed gauntlet reads clearly. In the death pose the body lies inside the flattened halo rings and orbit band, which is busy but still readable.

topFixes: Pull the brass toward the concept's darker bronze (chest near (70,55,41), hue about 25 deg) and tame the cream skirt and ring highlights, since colour has not moved since the 72 and 77 reviews and is now the largest single gap.

Rebuild the side profile and head: give the torso chest depth with layered pauldrons, move the orbit band behind the shoulders, and reshape the egg head into the concept's elongated skull mask with narrow eye slits and a raised brow plate.

Finish the lower legs and core: replace the stepped greave cylinders with a calf swell that tapers to the ankle with knee cops, and shrink the core disc into a smaller keyhole in a ribbed bezel with a white-hot centre.
independentScore.method: Re-score of build d291e3c with the same five-criterion rubric as the previous independent scores (72, then 77), re-measuring everything rather than inheriting it. Compared the concept sheet at native resolution (stray Sentry artifact ignored) against the front and side panels of the fidelity compare, cropped and enlarged with Pillow (lower legs, head, side profile), the low-poly three-quarter render, the review sheet, and the in-engine idle, attack, hit, frozen and death shots. glow-close.jpg and p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg have identical sha256, so they are one shot, not two. Greave taper was measured as per-row widths of non-background pixel runs in the model front ortho panel and estimated from the outline in the concept front panel. Colour was measured only on the engine shots with Pillow and NumPy: median of warm saturated pixels (R over 200, R minus B over 80) in the core and eye regions, a 9x9 sample and 95th percentile in the core disc, and median, hue, lightness and 90th percentile of brass regions (chest, skirt, greave) against the same regions of the concept front view. The brightest pixels near the core (255,254,236) are brass speculars, not the core, so they were not counted as a white-hot centre. Author claims were credited only where visible: sabatons, fingered gauntlets, grooves and rivets, cheek recesses and the keyhole channel are confirmed; the slim taper is partial; the raised brow plate is not visible.
